quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
why: The judge grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity, which is the single-verse silence (e.g., Romans 1:3 and Galatians 4:4 naming no father) that the rule forbids as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
